decisions.reason: As a flagship presented as central to the firm's direction, it has high sunk investment and public commitment, making dropping unlikely under escalation of commitment.
A product line with several models that had its own website page indicates substantial investment and commitment, so management is likely to persist.
As a product line with several models and website mentions, it represents ongoing investment that management is inclined to continue justifying.
The rackable pallet line likely involved significant development resources, and without clear permanent failure, escalation of commitment favors keeping it.
Despite reduced website prominence from own page to mention, it still represents sunk costs and public commitment that management will likely defend.
As a single product with somewhat less visible commitment than the lines, it has a higher drop probability, but sunk investment still makes dropping relatively unlikely.
